messages.text: Column 4: amino acid G does not match codon NNN.
Column 8: amino acid Y does not match codon NNN.
Column 6: 'U' (selenocysteine) is not one of the 20 standard amino acids, so COAL did not check its codon (any codon accepted).
Column 4: amino acid N does not match codon NNN.
Column 8: amino acid I does not match codon NNN.

summary_text: 2 of 6 sequences have codons with unknown or ambiguous bases (e.g. N) that could not be checked: missing sequence data, not a genetic-code problem.
1 of 6 sequences contain non-standard amino acids (U, O, B, Z or J) whose codons were not checked.
methods_text: Codon alignments were built with COAL v0.5.0 (https://github.com/plumat-coal/COAL), which places each coding DNA sequence onto the protein multiple sequence alignment codon by codon (the method of PAL2NAL; Suyama et al. 2006), using the standard genetic code (NCBI translation table 1). Of 6 sequences, 3 matched their protein exactly; 2 contained codons with unknown or ambiguous bases (e.g. N) that could not be checked (kept in the alignment); and 1 contained non-standard amino acids (such as U, B or Z) whose codons were not checked. Command: coal pep.fasta nuc.fasta -o out.fa
